title: pcell: Brownian catalyst particles inside self-made Allen-Cahn cells form walled, dividing cells from noise
summary: phase_membrane with its catalyst field replaced by ~8000 discrete Brownian particles (mass 0.2, logistic duplication c S (1-K) phi, death 0.02, link production b S per particle, phi^2 Metropolis gate on steps into lower phi). From a uniform particle soup and noisy phi (t=0), domains coarsen and by t~1100 give ~20-25 round and peanut cells whose particles sit entirely inside the wall (particles.png); 5-9 persistent splits, max gen 2-3 on seeds 0-1, though the population looks near-frozen after t~4000. No claims yet: gate-off ablation and two-kind heredity runs come next.
